What we're celebrating
The Celebration

Four Reasons to Sail

This isn't just one milestone — it's four. We're sailing together to celebrate everything happening in the Villarreal family this season.

The cruise lines up with Carmen's 85th birthday on March 10th — right in the middle of the trip. Bardo's retiring, Albert is turning 29, and little Azara turns 5 the same day as her great-grandmother. We couldn't have planned the timing better if we tried.

Where we're going
5 Nights · Western Caribbean

Day-by-Day Itinerary

Two ports, two sea days. Plenty of time to relax and plenty of time to explore.

Liberty of the Seas departs Galveston Saturday afternoon and returns Thursday morning. Below is the planned itinerary — port times confirmed with Royal Caribbean. The two sea days are perfect for the family parties.
★ Embarkation · Royal Caribbean Terminal, Galveston
1
Sat
March 6, 2027 · Embarkation Day
Galveston, Texas
Board from 11:00 AM · Set sail 4:00 PM
Arrive at the Port of Galveston cruise terminal. Plan to check in 2–3 hours before sailing. Once aboard, the staterooms typically open around 1:30 PM and the buffet is open from boarding. Sail away from the deck as we leave the Texas coast.
2
Sun
March 7, 2027 · Day at Sea
Cruising the Gulf of Mexico
All day onboard
Pool deck, FlowRider surf simulator, mini-golf, the H2O Zone for the kids, ice show in Studio B, Saturday Night Fever in the Platinum Theater. A great day to settle in and find each other on the ship.
★ Costa Maya · Mahahual coast & Mayan jungle
3
Mon
March 8, 2027 · Port Day
Costa Maya, Mexico
In port most of the day
A laid-back fishing village turned cruise port on Mexico's Caribbean coast. Mayan ruins (Chacchoben) are the main draw — about 90 minutes inland. Closer to port, beach clubs in Mahahual offer a low-key afternoon for those who'd rather not travel.
★ Cozumel · The crown jewel port
4
Tue
March 9, 2027 · Port Day
Cozumel, Mexico
In port most of the day
Cozumel is the most visited port in the Western Caribbean for a reason — world-class snorkeling on the reef, Tulum and San Gervasio ruins on the mainland, beach clubs at Chankanaab, and an easy walkable downtown right off the pier with shops and restaurants.
5
Wed
March 10, 2027 · Day at Sea · Birthday Day
Cruising back toward Galveston
All day onboard · Carmen & Azara's birthday
The big one. Carmen turns 85 and Azara turns 5 — same birthday, separated by 80 years. We'll arrange a family dinner reservation onboard and ask the dining team about a birthday cake. Tell us in advance and we'll handle it.
★ Galveston Pleasure Pier · Stay an extra day if you can
6
Thu
March 11, 2027 · Disembarkation
Galveston, Texas
Arrive 6:00 AM · Off the ship by ~9:30 AM
Early arrival back in Galveston. Most guests are off the ship by mid-morning. Plan flights home for after 12:30 PM out of Houston Hobby (HOU) or after 1:30 PM out of Houston Bush Intercontinental (IAH) to give yourself a buffer.

Stateroom Options

The prices below are for two guests sharing a stateroom and include all taxes and port fees. Add a third or fourth guest at a reduced rate. To lock in the group rate you'll need a $50 per stateroom deposit by May 28, 2026.

Shore Excursions

Things to do in port

A starting list of options at each port — all live pricing, all bookable independently of Royal Caribbean.

You can also book excursions directly through Royal Caribbean's app — typically more expensive but with the guarantee that the ship will wait if your tour runs late. The options below are third-party tours via Viator with strong reviews; book through us if you want help coordinating the family.
Costa Maya · Monday, March 8
Chacchoben Mayan Ruins
★ 4.7 · 1,491 reviews · ~4.5 hours
The most popular ruins from Costa Maya. Bus to the site, ~2 hour guided tour, return to ship. Better mobility than Tulum — paths are flatter.
Starting from
$55
per person
Mahahual Beach Club Day
~2–5 hours · transportation included
For the family members who'd rather skip the ruins — a transfer to Mahahual village beach, lounge chairs, and easy access to ship. Lowest-cost option in port.
Starting from
$29
per person
Chacchoben Ruins + Mayan Family Visit
★ 4.9 · 102 reviews · ~5.5 hours
Adds a visit with a local Mayan family — traditional cooking demo, more cultural context. The standout option for the older relatives who want depth, not just sightseeing.
Starting from
$107
per person
Cozumel · Tuesday, March 9
Glass-Bottom Boat Snorkel Tour
★ 4.8 · 556 reviews · 2 hours
Best option for mixed-ability groups. Non-snorkelers stay on the boat and watch the reef through the glass; snorkelers jump in. Short enough that the kids won't get cranky.
Starting from
$35
per person
Turtle Sanctuary Snorkel Tour
★ 4.6 · 1,140 reviews · 4 hours
Snorkel with sea turtles at El Cielo and the sanctuary at Punta Sur. Aven and Avery would love this — clear water, easy depth, lots to see.
Starting from
$65
per person
Private Van — Your Day, Your Way
★ 4.9 · 621 reviews · 5 hours · private vehicle
Best for a multi-generational group. Private van with driver-guide, build your own route — mix beach, downtown, and a cultural stop. Per-vehicle pricing, so the cost-per-person drops fast with a bigger group.
Starting from

per vehicle
Cozumel Ruins + Beach Break
★ 4.9 · 248 reviews · 5 hours · private tour
San Gervasio ruins (smaller and quieter than Tulum, no ferry needed) plus a beach club afternoon. The best of both worlds in a single trip.

How to claim your stateroom
Booking Process

How to Book Your Cabin

Four steps. The deposit window is the only thing on a deadline — everything else can be paid later.

Call or email Signature Elite
Reach out to (737) 271-7668 or bookings@signatureelitetravel.com. Mention Group #1006708 — Villarreal Family Cruise. Tell us how many guests, ages of any kids, and which stateroom category you'd like.
$50 deposit per stateroom
A $50 per stateroom deposit by May 28, 2026 locks in the group rate. Just $50 — not per person. The rest is due closer to sailing.
Final payment
Royal Caribbean's standard final payment date for this sailing is December 6, 2026 (90 days before sailing). We'll send a reminder before then. Payment plans available — ask us.
Travel documents
A passport book is strongly recommended for this itinerary (Mexico ports). A passport card or birth certificate + state ID is technically acceptable for closed-loop cruises, but a passport is far less risky if anything goes wrong in port. We'll send you a checklist after deposit.
Reach out
Reservations & Questions

Let's Get Your Cabin Reserved

Stone and the Signature Elite team are handling every booking for this group. Reach out by phone or email — whichever is easier.
